name: Co-parenting rhythm
summary: Keep co-parenting steady with a handoff checklist, a shared decisions list and a monthly check-in agenda.

onboarding.reaction: Got it. Handoffs go on the calendar.
Those go on the monthly agenda.

onboarding.prompt: What tone works best between you?
Invite your co-parent to see the shared plan?
onboarding.reaction: They'll see only what you choose.

plan_blueprint.calendar: Handoff reminders with the checklist, and a monthly check-in at the chosen slot with an agenda attached.

approach_variants.habit: Same checklist every handoff; streak of smooth handoffs.
approach_variants.willpower: Monthly challenge: settle one open decision.
approach_variants.time: Handoffs and check-ins are calendar blocks with times.
approach_variants.reward: Pick a small treat for yourself after each check-in.
approach_variants.resource: First weeks gather school calendars, medical info and contacts in one place.

guardrails: GoalKin offers prompts and planning, not counselling or therapy. If things feel stuck or painful, a licensed counsellor can help.
If you ever feel unsafe with someone, put your safety first and contact local emergency services or a support line.
GoalKin is not legal advice and does not replace a parenting plan or court order.
Children's details stay private by default.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A missed check-in is offered again the next week with a shorter agenda. If check-ins stall for two months, the plan suggests a written update instead of a meeting.
